description: ChatGPT model access through HKU GenAI.
howToObtain: HKU staff and students sign in to HKU GenAI App or the relevant ITS API Developer Portal. Check course instructions separately.
costToUser: Quota-based: students receive 500,000 AI Credits monthly, shared across the app and API; additional credits may be purchased. Staff limits differ.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: Microsoft Foundry ChatGPT and GPT Image DeepSeek Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform Gemini and Nano Banana GLM Qwen
Students have monthly 500k AI Credits which will be replenished on the first day of each month. AI Credits apply across both HKU GenAI App and the API Developer Portal.

description: GitHub Copilot Pro through GitHub Education; block public-code matching suggestions and disable model training in the settings required by HKU.
howToObtain: Apply through GitHub Education using a GitHub account with 2FA and billing address (no payment method required); eligibility is verified. ITS describes application and activation, but live approval availability was not tested.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: GitHub Copilot Pro is available to all HKU staff and students at no additional charge through GitHub Education benefits.
